title: Practice: a coordinator that delegates to isolated subagents (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 a hub sends one brief to each spoke and synthesizes what comes back
cases.says: A hub sends one brief to each spoke, in order, and synthesizes what comes back

cases.id: e1 a question the coordinator can answer itself is answered without any subagent
cases.says: A question the planner answers itself starts no team

cases.id: e2 a subagent sees its own brief and nothing the others found
cases.says: A subagent receives exactly its own brief

cases.id: e3 the plan is cleaned of empty briefs and duplicate scopes and capped
cases.says: Empty briefs and duplicate scopes are dropped, the team is capped, a plan with nothing usable fails without calls

cases.id: e4 a failing subagent does not stop the others and a run with no findings does not synthesize
cases.says: One failing subagent does not stop the others; a run with no findings neither reviews nor synthesizes

cases.id: e5 a review sends only the gaps back out and stops when none are left
cases.says: A review sends only the gaps out again, cleaned, and stops when none are left

cases.id: e6 the rounds are capped and the gaps that remain are reported
cases.says: The rounds are capped, the gaps that remain are reported and the status is partial
